\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ارز} (arz)}{ارز (arz)}]{\fa{ارز} (arz) — foreign currency}

\label{lesson:FA-C414-arz}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a subsidy, then the Persian for a rate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ارز}}
\textbf{\fa{ارز}} (\emph{arz}) — \textquotedblleft{}foreign currency\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{نرخ} \fa{ارز} \fa{امروز} \fa{بالا} \fa{رفت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nerkh-e arz emruz bâlâ raft.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The exchange rate went up today.
\end{quote}

Different from \emph{arzesh} \textquotedblleft{}value\textquotedblright{}. \emph{Arz-e khâreji} — foreign currency.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{ارز}} \textquotedblleft{}currency\textquotedblright{} is listed in EtymDB without a parent, and its origin is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{arz}, once more

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a subsidy, then the Persian for a rate, then say \emph{arz} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{اعتبار} (e'tebâr)}{اعتبار (e'tebâr)}]{\fa{اعتبار} (e'tebâr) — credit; validity}

\label{lesson:FA-C414-etebar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a rate, then the Persian for foreign currency.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{اعتبار}}
\textbf{\fa{اعتبار}} (\emph{e'tebâr}) — \textquotedblleft{}credit; validity\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{اعتبار} \fa{این} \fa{کارت} \fa{تا} \fa{آخر} \fa{ماه} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{e'tebâr-e in kârt tâ âkhar-e mâh ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This card is valid until the end of the month.
\end{quote}

Also trust or standing: \emph{e'tebâr dâshtan}. \emph{Kârt-e e'tebâri} — a credit card.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{اعتبار}} comes from Arabic \emph{i'tibār} \textquotedblleft{}regard, consideration\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB): credit is the regard others have for you.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{e'tebâr}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a rate, then the Persian for foreign currency, then say \emph{e'tebâr} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{سپرده} (seporde)}{سپرده (seporde)}]{\fa{سپرده} (seporde) — a deposit, savings}

\label{lesson:FA-C414-seporde}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for foreign currency, then the Persian for credit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{سپرده}}
\textbf{\fa{سپرده}} (\emph{seporde}) — \textquotedblleft{}a deposit, savings\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{پولش} \fa{را} \fa{در} \fa{بانک} \fa{سپرده} \fa{گذاشت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u pulash râ dar bânk seporde gozâsht.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He put his money in a savings deposit at the bank.
\end{quote}

The past participle of \emph{sepordan} \textquotedblleft{}to entrust\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{سپرده}} is native Persian, the past participle of \emph{sepordan} \textquotedblleft{}to entrust, to deposit\textquotedblright{}, which EtymDB traces to Middle Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{برداشت} \fa{کردن} (bardâsht kardan)}{برداشت کردن (bardâsht kardan)}]{\fa{برداشت} \fa{کردن} (bardâsht kardan) — to withdraw (money)}

\label{lesson:FA-C414-bardasht-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for credit, then the Persian for a deposit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{برداشت} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{برداشت} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{bardâsht kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to withdraw (money)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{از} \fa{خودپرداز} \fa{صد} \fa{هزار} \fa{تومان} \fa{برداشت} \fa{کردم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{az khodpardâz sad hezâr tumân bardâsht kardam.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I withdrew a hundred thousand tomans from the cash machine.
\end{quote}

\emph{Az hesâb bardâsht kardan} — to withdraw from an account. Also to harvest.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{برداشت} \fa{کردن}} is native Persian, built from \emph{bardâsht} \textquotedblleft{}taking up\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{bar} \textquotedblleft{}up\textquotedblright{} and \emph{dâsht}, the past stem of \emph{dâshtan} \textquotedblleft{}to hold\textquotedblright{}, with \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{انتقال} \fa{دادن} (enteqâl dâdan)}{انتقال دادن (enteqâl dâdan)}]{\fa{انتقال} \fa{دادن} (enteqâl dâdan) — to transfer, to move}

\label{lesson:FA-C414-enteqal-dadan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a deposit, then the Persian for to withdraw.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{انتقال} \fa{دادن}}
\textbf{\fa{انتقال} \fa{دادن}} (\emph{enteqâl dâdan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to transfer, to move\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پول} \fa{را} \fa{به} \fa{حساب} \fa{برادرم} \fa{انتقال} \fa{دادم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pul râ be hesâb-e barâdaram enteqâl dâdam.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I transferred the money to my brother's account.
\end{quote}

\emph{Enteqâl} \textquotedblleft{}transfer\textquotedblright{} + \emph{dâdan}. Also to move a patient or an office.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{انتقال}} comes from Arabic \emph{intiqāl} \textquotedblleft{}moving, passing\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB); with \emph{dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{} it means to move something on.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a deposit, then the Persian for to withdraw, then say \emph{enteqâl dâdan} again
\end{itemize}
